_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/casting/test_graveyard_cast_grant.py. t_yawgmoth is Urabrask's third chapter as a sorcery that exiles itself -- the exile is the point, since the whole difference from a static is that the permission outlives its source. t_own_graveyard is the same grant without `any_graveyard`, kept live because it is the narrower card the widening must not hand out for free.

cards.name: Test Yawgmoth's Will
cards.oracle_text: Until end of turn, you may cast instant and sorcery spells from any graveyard. If a spell cast this way would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead. Exile Test Yawgmoth's Will.

cards.name: Test Lesser Will
cards.oracle_text: Until end of turn, you may cast instant and sorcery spells from your graveyard. Exile Test Lesser Will.
